# sgit.ai's vault reader, pinned

`vault-embed.js` as served by https://sgit.ai/assets/vault-embed.js on 5 November 2026, copied unmodified from
PrompTugal.news's pinned copy (`PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website`, `assets/vendor/sgit-ai/2026-11-05/`, same
sha256), Apache-2.0. The newsroom's video player (`assets/vault-video/vault-video.js`) uses its `Reader` to read the
media vault from its published read key in the browser: derive the ref id, fetch ciphertext, decrypt with Web Crypto.
Nothing here is edited; to update, copy the file again into a new dated folder and record its sha256.

```
62fad48efeb23bbb869f5b14f854cfd856c1f25e50ad02061babc4d338173064  vault-embed.js
```
